name: ci_pipeline_cicd
title: Automated CI/CD Pipeline with Multi-Environment Deployment
description: Design and implement a CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions that supports automated building, testing, code signing, and deployment to TestFlight and App Store Connect. Pipeline must handle multiple environments (dev, staging, production), manage certificates and provisioning profiles, and provide deployment status notifications.

requirements.description: GitHub Actions workflow for PR validation (build + test + lint)
Automated code signing with match for development and distribution certificates
TestFlight deployment on merge to develop branch
App Store Connect submission on tagged releases
Environment-specific configuration injection (API URLs, feature flags)
Build caching for Swift Package Manager dependencies
Slack notification on build success/failure with artifact links
Full pipeline execution time under 20 minutes for PR validation
Secrets management using GitHub encrypted secrets with rotation schedule

constraints: Must use GitHub Actions (no third-party CI services)
No plaintext secrets in workflow files
Must support concurrent pipeline runs without conflicts
